ref: <bare branch name at admission, e.g. claude/forgehold-phase1; the lane rejects refs/...>
commit: <40-hex commit; must equal the live GitHub head of ref at launch>
log_required: RQ_JSON {"job":"forgehold-reference-guard","stage":"checkout","result":"PASS","commit":"<the same 40-hex commit as the commit field>"
expiry_epoch: <INTEGER unix epoch seconds in the real tuple (not a string): agreement end minus margin; launch is refused within 600 s of it>
